brief:
Netanyahu may order a military strike against Iran even if he loses upcoming elections, according to an American report, the Ma'an news agency reported. The assessment suggests the Israeli prime minister could pursue such action as a means to maintain political leverage or influence the electoral outcome before voting concludes.

American officials have expressed concern about potential escalation in the region ahead of Israeli elections, according to the report, which does not specify timing or circumstances that might trigger such an operation.
title: American report says Netanyahu may order Iran attack despite election loss
